item.tib: spyi 'dus dran pa'i thugs tig las rtsa gsum yang snying bsgrub pa gsang chen yid bzhin nor bu'i rgya mtsho
item.coloph: ces spyi 'dus dran pa'i thugs tig las rtsa gsum yang snying gi sgrub thabs gsang chen yid bzhin nor bu'i rgya mtsho 'di snga lo gnyen rje gab tog shel gyi rdo ring nas rnyed pa'i gter gyi kha byang las rgyal kun mes po'i smri ti yi thugs tig gyim shod gnas la yod bstan 'gro'i dpal gyi sgron me de dam sri rdzi yi 'da' la re zhes gsungs pa dang ma zad 'dzam gling gnas brgya'i gtso bo gyer gyi ri gsum 'dus pa'i 'gro don dus la phebs thog lam bar duH rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du phyin pa'i snang ba shar tshe yab cig dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) zhal 'dzum par dang bcas te a ho rig brgya'i 'dus gtso nga nyid kyis bsgrub thabs shel le rdzong du yod rdzu 'phrul rtsal gyis len par 'os zhes sogs lung snga phyi'i (phyis) bsngags bzhin rig 'dzin gyi tshogs bskang (skong) rgya cher 'bul zhing gter bdag nye bar bskul rjes yul zhang zhung sgo phug bar gyi phyi sgo shod chen bco brgyad la gyim shod khyung gi yul rdzong drug la shel le rdzong ces pa 'chi med dran pa yab sras la sogs rig 'dzin grub chen brgyad bcu'i rtags su (rtag tu) gzigs pas (pa'i) gnas khyad par 'phags pa la gter bdag gyis gnas su khyer te ka ye rig 'dzin thugs kyi sras 'chi med dran pa'i thugs tig 'di las kyi 'phro ldan khyod la sprad rgyal bstan nyi 'od gsal ba yis 'gro kun sdug bsngal mtsho skems mdzod ces zer cing mdun du tshag sgra dang bcas te lhung byung bar kha rang dbye song nas dri bzang spos kyi ngad pa nyu thu le ru byung zhing dam du dril bar byas slar rim can bka' rgya grol tshe sems dpa' smon rgyal nam mkha' grags pa dang sems dpa' kun mkhyen thugs rje thugs rje nyi ma'am/ bstan sbyin so brgyad mkhan po g.yung drung 'gyur med lung zin sprul sku spa ston bstan pa 'brug grags bka' babs rgyal sprul blo ldan dang dbus phug mtshams pa rin po che stag bro mkhan po dad sbyin bra'o dbra khyung sogs las can yongs kyi ngo bskal (skal) du lcags rta zla tshes bzang por stag bro g.yung drung dga' tshal du o rgyan pad ma gling pas shog ser las zhal bshus te thog ma'i drung yig pa ni sems dpa' thugs rje nyi ma dngos slob phrin las lhun grub a mdo drung yig bra bo rgya mtsho bcas mi ngo bzhi yis byas te gtan la phabs (phab) grub pa'o
